pages.text: toNeko provides $(#FF69B4)8 exclusive enchantments$() across different equipment. These cannot be obtained from a regular enchanting table — they must be acquired through the aggregator or other special means.

pages.title: General Enchantments
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Enforcement$() (Level 1) — for $(item)Contract$(): essential for taming bratty nekos. Can also be put on armor to prevent hatred buildup when hitting nekos.$(li)$(thing)Reversion$() (Level 1) — for $(item)Neko Armor$() (ears/tail), creates a curious reversal effect with the armor itself.$(br2)These two aren't weighted highly for acquisition, but their unique effects make them worth collecting.

pages.title: Hiss Series · Part 1
pages.text: The following 5 enchantments are exclusive to the $(item)Neko Energy Burst$():$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hiss Power$() (Lv.3 / Weight 10) — increases energy burst damage$(li)$(thing)Hiss Spread$() (Lv.3 / Weight 8) — expands energy burst radius$(li)$(thing)Hiss Efficiency$() (Lv.3 / Weight 8) — reduces energy consumption$(br2)The Hiss series is the core enhancement for the Neko Energy Burst — a good combination will take your AoE output to the next level!

pages.title: Hiss Series · Part 2
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Hiss Root$() (Lv.2 / Weight 6) — chance to briefly root enemies on hit$(li)$(thing)Hiss Demolish$() (Lv.3 / Weight 6) — adds explosive effect and area destruction$(br2)The Root + Demolish combo is devastating against mob groups — root them first, then blow them all up together!

pages.title: Combo Extend
pages.text: $(thing)Combo Extend$() (Lv.2 / Weight 4) — for $(item)Neko Energy Burst$().$(br2)Effect: $(#FF69B4)extends the combo time window$(), making it easier to maintain high combos.$(br2)For players who love pushing their combo counts to the limit, this is a must-have enchantment — after all, the higher the combo, the flashier the energy burst becomes!
